text: Hello and welcome to Real Easy English,
zh: 大家好,欢迎来到"Real Easy English"。
zh_hant: 大家好,歡迎來到"Real Easy English"。

text: the podcast where we have real conversations in easy English to help you learn.
zh: 这是我们用简单英语进行真实对话的播客，帮助你学习。
zh_hant: 這是我們用簡單英語進行真實對話的播客，幫助你學習。

text: I'm Neil.
And I'm Beth.
You can find a video version of this podcast and a worksheet to help you learn on our website,
zh: 你可以在我们的网站上找到这个播客的视频版本和一份帮助你学习的工作表，
zh_hant: 你可以在我們的網站上找到這個播客的影片版本和一份幫助你學習的工作表，

text: bbclearningenglish.com.
How are you today, Beth?
I'm OK, Neil.
I'm a little bit tired.
How are you?
I'm very well.
I'm fine.
Great.
Good, good.
Well, today we're going to talk about mistakes .
So hopefully I won't make many mistakes , being tired.
zh: 希望我因为累了也不会犯太多错误。
zh_hant: 希望我因為累了也不會犯太多錯誤。

text: No. , mistakes can be things that are wrong,
zh: 不,错误可以是那些不对的事情,
zh_hant: 不,錯誤可以是那些不對的事情,

text: like a mistake in a maths problem.
zh: 就像数学题里的一个错误。
zh_hant: 就像數學題裡的一個錯誤。

text: But we can also use mistake to talk about really big
zh: 但是我们也可以用mistake来指非常严重的错误
zh_hant: 但是我們也可以用mistake來指非常嚴重的錯誤

text: things in life.
Decisions that you've made, actions that you've taken.
zh: 你做过的决定,你采取过的行动。
zh_hant: 你做過的決定,你採取過的行動。

text: Yes.
That's true.
So I think let's start the conversation.
Let's do it.
So, Beth, have you made any mistakes recently?
zh: 贝丝,你最近犯过什么错误吗?
zh_hant: 貝絲,你最近犯過什麼錯誤嗎?

text: Yes.
So I recently left my suitcase on a train by mistake .
zh: 所以我最近不小心把行李箱落在了火车上。
zh_hant: 所以我最近不小心把行李箱落在了火車上。

text: Oh, no.
So I was travelling from home to Leeds on the train.
zh: 所以我当时正坐火车从家前往利兹。
zh_hant: 所以我當時正坐火車從家前往利茲。

text: And I got to the station at Leeds,
and there were loads of people, and they were, they were football fans
zh: 当时有好多人,他们都是球迷
zh_hant: 當時有好多人,他們都是球迷

text: and they were singing really loudly.
And I just wanted to get off the train.
And that's what I did.
And then I realised about half an hour later
zh: 半个小时后我才意识到
zh_hant: 半個小時後我才意識到

text: that I didn't have my suitcase.
Oh no.
So...
That's a bad mistake .
Did you get it back?
I did, I was so lucky.
zh: 我做到了,我真的很幸运。
zh_hant: 我做到了,我真的很幸運。

text: The train stopped at Leeds.
So when I realised I ran and said to the people on the platform,
zh: 所以当我意识到这一点时，我跑过去对站台上的人说，
zh_hant: 所以當我意識到這一點時，我跑過去對站臺上的人說，

text: "My suitcase is on the train!"
And they held the train for me and I ran up the platform.
zh: 他们为我留了车,我沿着站台跑过去。
zh_hant: 他們為我留了車,我沿著站臺跑過去。

text: I grabbed my suitcase
and then they blew the whistle and the train went.
zh: 然后他们吹了哨子,火车就开了。
zh_hant: 然後他們吹了哨子,火車就開了。

text: I was so lucky.
But yeah, that was a big mistake .
zh: 不过没错,那是个很大的错误。
zh_hant: 不過沒錯,那是個很大的錯誤。

text: And I will not make that mistake again.
zh: 我不会再犯那个错误了。
zh_hant: 我不會再犯那個錯誤了。

text: Everybody says that.
So earlier we said that mistakes can be small things,
zh: 所以之前我们说，错误可以是小事情，
zh_hant: 所以之前我們說，錯誤可以是小事情，

text: like my suitcase.
But there are big mistakes that we can make.
zh: 但我们可能会犯一些大错误。
zh_hant: 但我們可能會犯一些大錯誤。

text: So have you ever made a big mistake , do you think?
zh: 你觉得你有没有犯过什么大错误?
zh_hant: 你覺得你有沒有犯過什麼大錯誤?

text: Yeah.
Well, once I had a job that I really, really enjoyed,
zh: 我曾经有过一份我真的非常喜欢的工作,
zh_hant: 我曾經有過一份我真的非常喜歡的工作,

text: I was teaching at a school
zh: 我当时在一所学校教书
zh_hant: 我當時在一所學校教書

text: in Prague, in the Czech Republic, teaching English,
and I loved the job and I had loads of really good friends.
zh: 我很喜欢那份工作,也交到了很多很棒的朋友。
zh_hant: 我很喜歡那份工作,也交到了很多很棒的朋友。

text: But I had this feeling
that I needed to go move somewhere else, do something else with my life.
zh: 我需要搬到别的地方去，去做些别的事情来过我的人生。
zh_hant: 我需要搬到別的地方去，去做些別的事情來過我的人生。

text: And so I resigned.
But then about a week or so later,
I realised that I really, really didn't want to leave
zh: 我意识到我真的非常不想离开
zh_hant: 我意識到我真的非常不想離開

text: that school.
So I went back to the boss
and I said, "I've changed my mind.
I want to stay".
And he said, "Well, it's too late
because I've given your job to somebody else".
zh: 我已经把你的工作给了别人。
zh_hant: 我已經把你的工作給了別人。

text: Oh, no, that's so sad.
So you left your job?
Left Prague?
No, actually, a bit like your suitcase, Beth,
zh: 不,其实有点像你的行李箱,贝丝,
zh_hant: 不,其實有點像你的行李箱,貝絲,

text: it ended up,
it ended up being OK because the person who took my job then decided that he didn't want the job either.
zh: 结果还挺好的，因为接手我职位的那个人后来也决定不想要这份工作了。
zh_hant: 結果還挺好的，因為接手我職位的那個人後來也決定不想要這份工作了。

text: So in the end, I did stay.
So when we make mistakes , Neil,
sometimes we then have a regret or we regret the thing that we did.
zh: 有时我们会后悔，或者后悔我们所做的事情。
zh_hant: 有時我們會後悔，或者後悔我們所做的事情。

text: That means that we feel bad about it.
zh: 这意味着我们对此感到内疚。
zh_hant: 這意味著我們對此感到內疚。

text: Or we wish that we'd done something differently.
zh: 我们希望自己当初做了不一样的选择。
zh_hant: 我們希望自己當初做了不一樣的選擇。

text: Do you have any regrets ?
Yeah.
When I was a kid, I guess I was probably 12 or 13,
zh: 我小时候,大概十二三岁的时候,
zh_hant: 我小時候,大概十二三歲的時候,

text: I had some piano lessons,
and I quit as soon as I could.
zh: 而我一旦能走就立刻辞职了。
zh_hant: 而我一旦能走就立刻辭職了。

text: My parents gave me that choice.
zh: 我父母给了我那个选择的机会。
zh_hant: 我父母給了我那個選擇的機會。

text: And I regret that because I love music and I play guitar,
zh: 我很后悔,因为我热爱音乐,还会弹吉他,
zh_hant: 我很後悔,因為我熱愛音樂,還會彈吉他,

text: and I think I would have enjoyed playing piano.
zh: 我觉得我本来会喜欢弹钢琴的。
zh_hant: 我覺得我本來會喜歡彈鋼琴的。

text: I always think, to be honest,
zh: 老实说,我一直都这么认为,
zh_hant: 老實說,我一直都這麼認為,

text: you shouldn't have any regrets ,
because whatever you've done, you've learnt something from it.
zh: 因为无论你做了什么,你都能从中学到一些东西。
zh_hant: 因為無論你做了什麼,你都能從中學到一些東西。

text: Even if something bad happened,
zh: 即使发生了不好的事情,
zh_hant: 即使發生了不好的事情,

text: then you know for next time.
And it's a kind of self-improvement thing.
zh: 这是一种自我提升的方式。
zh_hant: 這是一種自我提升的方式。

text: That is a very positive attitude to mistakes , Beth.
zh: 贝丝,你对待错误的态度非常积极。
zh_hant: 貝絲,你對待錯誤的態度非常積極。

text: Yeah, I think it's important to learn from your mistakes .
zh: 是的，我认为从错误中学习很重要。
zh_hant: 是的，我認為從錯誤中學習很重要。

text: And that's a common expression
in English, to learn from your mistakes .
zh: 在英语中，从错误中学习。
zh_hant: 在英語中，從錯誤中學習。

text: Let's recap the vocabulary we've learnt in this podcast.
zh: 我们来回顾一下这期播客中学到的词汇。
zh_hant: 我們來回顧一下這期播客中學到的詞彙。

text: Starting with mistake .
And a mistake is an action that is wrong
zh: 犯错就是做了错误的行为。
zh_hant: 犯錯就是做了錯誤的行為。

text: or that you do when you don't mean to.
zh: 不是故意做出来的那种。
zh_hant: 不是故意做出來的那種。

text: And we can make a mistake .
That means we do something wrong.
zh: 这说明我们做错了什么。
zh_hant: 這說明我們做錯了什麼。

text: Or we can do something by mistake ,
zh: 我们也可能不小心做了某件事,
zh_hant: 我們也可能不小心做了某件事,

text: which means we do something accidentally without meaning to.
zh: 意思是我们无意中做了某事,并非故意的。
zh_hant: 意思是我們無意中做了某事,並非故意的。

text: For example, I left my suitcase on the train by mistake .
zh: 例如，我不小心把行李箱落在了火车上。
zh_hant: 例如，我不小心把行李箱落在了火車上。

text: We also heard regret ,
which means feel bad or sorry about something
zh: 意思是对某事感到难过或抱歉
zh_hant: 意思是對某事感到難過或抱歉

text: you've done or a mistake that you've made.
zh: 你做过的事或犯过的错误。
zh_hant: 你做過的事或犯過的錯誤。

text: And we heard learn from your mistakes ,
zh: 我们听过“从错误中学习”这句话
zh_hant: 我們聽過“從錯誤中學習”這句話

text: which means remember the mistake
zh: 这意味着要记住这个错误
zh_hant: 這意味著要記住這個錯誤

text: and then not do it again the next time.
zh: 然后下次又不这样做了。
zh_hant: 然後下次又不這樣做了。

text: That's it for this episode of Real Easy English.
zh: 《Real Easy English》这期节目就到这里。
zh_hant: 《Real Easy English》這期節目就到這裡。

text: You can test yourself on what you've learned with a worksheet on our website,
zh: 你可以在我们网站上的练习题中检测一下自己学到的内容。
zh_hant: 你可以在我們網站上的練習題中檢測一下自己學到的內容。

text: bbclearningenglish.com.
Next week we'll be talking about trains, buses and public transport.
zh: 下周我们将讨论火车、公交车和公共交通。
zh_hant: 下週我們將討論火車、公交車和公共交通。

text: See you then.
Goodbye.
Bye.
